Abstract excerpt: In this work, we introduce WeSCE, a benchmark for quantifying security drift in code editing under weak-security constraints, where tasks specify only functional objectives without explicit security requirements. WeSCE consists of 400 executable programs derived from real-world code, covering feature addition, feature removal, bug fixing, and refactoring.
